chunks: On the day when God will raise them up together, He will tell them what they did. God takes account of it although they forget, for all things are evident to God.
ai.seo_question: What happens to human deeds on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual nature of divine knowledge: while human memory is fallible and deeds may be forgotten, Allah’s recording is exhaustive and precise. It underscores the concept of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen), affirming that God’s witness is not merely observational but encompasses the complete reality of every action, serving as a basis for just recompense on the Day of Judgment.
